name: Drop'edthe.tech
tagline: A fast bot that completes a university drop-out on the sponsor's test portal by calling its backend directly.

awards: Deck - Sponsor Challenge // Deck - Défi commandité

problem: The sponsor challenge asked for automation that reliably completes a bureaucratic web workflow.
solution: A JavaScript bot that calls the portal's backend APIs for speed, with Puppeteer to show results, packaged as an Electron app with a download site.
demo_moment: Team-described: run the bot and watch the drop-out complete.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Deck - Sponsor Challenge // Deck - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Optimised for speed by skipping the user interface.

lessons: Sometimes the best agent is no agent: call the API.
